| **Hold; do not request now:** Assessor records and building declarations; SB Resolution 103-86 and Gloria's terms; Building Official permits | Assessor (an ARTA respondent's office); SB Secretary (Princess's workplace); Building Official (Erwin himself) | High | Subpoena at rebuttal only, after their witnesses have sworn |

Every request is made truthfully, in Jonathan's own name as attorney-in-fact, for records the law lets an owner obtain. No pretext. Nothing is said to any office about the case beyond the request, and no Registry officer is ever named as a source.
